first_step_test: The low oval and short curved rim set the rook width and its fixed base on the page; a beginner can copy them before judging the height.

source.notes: First six-cell sheet rejected because closed turret disappeared. From revised sheet, saved panels 1, 2, 4, 5, 6 were selected into a five-cell raster contact sheet, omitting the redundant closed-top panel 3. Original rejected sheet remains private.

final_elements.name: bottom base oval
final_elements.description: One shallow horizontal oval centered below the rook, in its final position.

final_elements.name: base rim
final_elements.description: Two short curves make a low pedestal above the bottom oval.

final_elements.name: tapered shaft
final_elements.description: Two gently inward-sloping sides rise from the base rim to the neck.

final_elements.name: neck collar
final_elements.description: One narrow curved band caps the shaft.

final_elements.name: turret bowl
final_elements.description: A broader open-top turret rises above the collar and connects directly to battlements.

final_elements.name: three battlements
final_elements.description: Three squared stone tabs on the top silhouette with two open notches.

final_elements.name: front stone seams
final_elements.description: Two short staggered stone seams on the shaft.

final_elements.name: board square
final_elements.description: One lightly tilted quadrilateral below and behind the rook base.

final_elements.name: contact shadow
final_elements.description: A broken graphite oval shadow under the base within the square.

frames.visible_job: Place the shallow oval and low pedestal rim.
frames.instruction: Draw a shallow oval near the lower center. Add a short curve above it and connect the ends to make a low pedestal.

frames.visible_job: Add two gently sloping tower sides and their curved top.
frames.instruction: From the inner ends of the pedestal, pull two gently inward-sloping sides upward and join their tops with a light curve.

frames.visible_job: Add the neck collar, wider turret face, and three connected battlements.
frames.instruction: Wrap a narrow collar around the shaft top. Widen into a shallow turret above it, then draw three square tabs separated by two open notches as one continuous top edge.

frames.visible_job: Add two shaft seams, a tilted board square and contact shadow.
frames.instruction: Mark two short staggered stone seams on the shaft. Draw one tilted square behind the base and shade a broken contact oval beneath it.

final_step.visible_job: Darken existing keeper contours and add restrained graphite shading without new structure.
final_step.instruction: Strengthen the existing battlements, collar, shaft, and base with 2B pencil. Hatch the right side and deepen the marked contact shadow; leave the board square pale.

visual_review.first_step_observation: The first saved square crop has one centered shallow oval and a short curved rim above it; the open paper above leaves an easy width anchor for a new learner.
visual_review.draw_through_observation: Five selected saved crops retain the same pedestal, tapered shaft, collar, three battlements and two notches, then add two shaft seams, one board square and a broken contact shadow before right-side graphite hatching. The initially generated closed-turret panel was omitted because its top would have required an unexplained erasure. No temporary guides appear or disappear in the approved five-crop sequence.

transitions.observed_addition: The same low pedestal keeps its width and position; two sloping sides rise to a short curved shaft top.
transitions.instruction_match: The second instruction starts both sides at the established pedestal and closes their tops.

transitions.observed_addition: The base and tapered shaft stay fixed; a narrow neck band and broad castle face appear above, capped by three square tabs and two open notches. The earlier shaft top is covered by the new collar.
transitions.instruction_match: The third instruction wraps the collar around the shaft top and builds the turret with three tabs.

transitions.observed_addition: The complete rook remains at the same anchors; two staggered seams appear on the shaft, and a lightly tilted square and broken contact shadow appear behind the base.
transitions.instruction_match: The fourth instruction names the two seams, the square behind the rook, and the shadow below it.

transitions.observed_addition: The three tabs, two notches, collar, seams, board corners and base anchors persist; graphite darkens the right turret and shaft and deepens the same contact shadow.
transitions.instruction_match: The final instruction shades only existing stone planes and shadow while leaving the board square pale.
